title: Onion Nutrient Deficiency: Signs, Causes and the Fertilizer That Fixes It
metaTitle: Onion Nutrient Deficiency: Signs and Fertilizer Fix
metaDescription: Onion nutrient deficiency shows in the leaves. See the signs of nitrogen, sulfur and potassium in sibuyas, how to be sure, and the fertilizer to apply.
excerpt: Onion nutrient deficiency is one of the first things to check when the leaves of your sibuyas (onion) turn yellow, purple or burnt at the edges. On Philippine farms the usual ones are nitrogen, sulfur, potassium, phosphorus, zinc, boron, magnesium, copper and manganese. This guide shows where each one starts, how to be sure, and the fertilizer that fixes it.

blocks.text: Start with one question: did the change begin on the old leaves or on the young ones? Nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus and magnesium move inside the plant, so a shortage shows on the old, lower leaves first. But sulfur, zinc, boron, copper and manganese stay where the plant first put them, so the young leaves and the growing tip show it first. After that, the color and the pattern narrow down which onion nutrient deficiency you have, and a soil test confirms it. Each one below has its signs, its causes and its fix.

blocks.text: Before you buy fertilizer for a onion nutrient deficiency

So use the table to pick the likeliest onion nutrient deficiency, then read its section below. Also keep in mind that dry soil, standing water, cold nights, a pest or a disease can look the same. That is why it pays to check the roots and the whole field first.
Nitrogen deficiency in onion

Plants stay short with pale green to yellow leaves that stand stiff and upright and die back from the tips, starting on the older leaves. Bulbs stay small and mature early, and the neck tissue above the bulb turns soft at maturity. You see it most at this stage: from transplanting to the start of bulbing.
Why nitrogen deficiency happens in sibuyas
Sandy soils, heavy rain or irrigation that washes nitrogen out, and too little fertilizer.
How to tell it apart

Sulfur deficiency yellows the young leaves first. Potassium deficiency first makes leaves darker, with wilting tips. To be sure, soil test before planting. A tissue test of the tallest leaf before bulbing (Haifa).
What to apply for nitrogen deficiency

Haifa gives 200 to 300 kg N per hectare for dry bulbs: a quarter or so before planting and the rest in splits every 10 to 14 days for 2 to 2.5 months. For quick help TNAU gives a 1 percent urea (10 g per liter) or 2 percent DAP spray twice, a week apart. A UPLB survey found most Nueva Ecija farmers already use more than 120 kg N per hectare. So check your rate before adding more.

Sold here with nitrogen: **Atlas Granular Urea** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (46 0 0), **YaraVera Viking Ship Granular Urea** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (46 0 0), **Planters Products Granular Urea** by Planters Products, Inc. (46 0 0) and **Harbest Granular Urea** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (46 0 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [urea fertilizer](/blog/urea-fertilizer), and the page on [nitrogen deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/nitrogen-deficiency) in every crop. In anee.io, Anee, the [smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician), reads a photo of the leaf and tells you which nutrient is short.
To keep it away, split nitrogen and stop before bulbing ends.
Sulfur deficiency in onion

The young leaves turn evenly yellow first, then the whole plant. Plants are thin, weak and spindly, and bulb formation and maturity are delayed. Bulbs are less pungent. You see it most at this stage: before bulbing.
Why sulfur deficiency happens in sibuyas
Sandy soils low in organic matter, sulfur free fertilizers such as urea and 14 14 14 used for years, and burning crop waste.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen deficiency starts on the older leaves. Iron deficiency yellows the youngest leaves completely but is rare. To be sure, soil and leaf test for sulfur.
What to apply for sulfur deficiency

Haifa gives 45 to 70 kg of sulfur per hectare, half at planting or transplanting and half before bulbing. On sulfur poor soil, 40 kg of sulfur per hectare as Ammonium sulfate 21 0 0 or single superphosphate with the usual NPK raised aggregatum onion yield by about a quarter (TNAU trial). KAU also uses sulfur dust, about 25 kg per hectare.

Sold here with sulfur: **Farmfix Sulfur** by Philippine FarmFix, Inc. (99 percent sulfur), **VSI Sulfur Powder** by Newman Chemicals Corporation (99.5 percent sulfur), **Atlas Ammosul** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (21 0 0 with 24 percent sulfur) and **Philphos 21 0 0** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (21 0 0 (ammonium sulfate)). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [ammonium sulfate fertilizer](/blog/ammonium-sulfate-21-0-0), and the page on [sulfur deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/sulfur-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, keep a sulfur source such as ammonium sulfate in every crop.
Potassium deficiency in onion

Foliage first turns darker green, then the tips of the older leaves wilt, especially on the upper side. Leaves droop, turn satiny and then papery, and yellow like nitrogen deficiency. Tip burn and early bolting are common, and bulbs stay small. You see it most at this stage: bulb development.
Why potassium deficiency happens in sibuyas
Sandy soils, soils cropped for years without potash, and heavy nitrogen without potash.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen deficiency gives pale, not dark, leaves at first. Purple blotch disease gives purple spots with rings. To be sure, soil test for potassium. Tissue test of the tallest leaf.
What to apply for potassium deficiency

Haifa advises putting 30 to 50 percent of the potash in before planting and the rest during bulb development, which increases bulb size. TNAU gives a 1 percent potassium sulfate spray (10 g per liter) twice, a week apart.

Sold here with potassium: **Atlas Muriate of Potash** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Philphos Muriate of Potash** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Harbest Granular Muriate of Potash** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (0 0 60) and **Swire Muriate of Potash** by Swire Agrotech Agricultural Products Inc. (0 0 60). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [potash fertilizer](/blog/potash-fertilizer), and the page on [potassium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/potassium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, split potash and keep the soil pH above 6.
Phosphorus deficiency in onion

Growth is slow and maturity late. Leaves turn a dull green and die back from the tips without the yellowing seen in nitrogen or potassium shortage, and some tips turn reddish. Many bulbs have thick necks or fail to form. You see it most at this stage: seedling to early bulbing.
Why phosphorus deficiency happens in sibuyas
Acid and volcanic soils, cold soils, and fields where the soil fungi that help onion take up phosphorus are few, such as after fumigation.
How to tell it apart
Manganese deficiency also gives thick necks but with yellow between veins of older leaves. To be sure, soil test: Haifa keeps available P at 25 ppm.
What to apply for phosphorus deficiency
Haifa adds 1 kg of phosphorus per hectare for every 1 ppm the soil test is below 25 ppm. For a standing crop TNAU gives a 2 percent DAP 18 46 0 spray (20 g per liter) twice, 15 days apart.

Sold here with phosphorus: **Triple Super Phosphate** by Newman Chemicals Corporation (0 46 0), **Sagrex Duofos Granular Guano Phosphate** by Sagrex Corporation (0 22 0 (guano phosphate)), **Philphos 18 46 0** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0 (diammonium phosphate)) and **Atlas Di Ammonium Phosphate** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [16 20 0 fertilizer](/blog/16-20-0-fertilizer), and the page on [phosphorus deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/phosphorus-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, apply phosphorus at planting, and add organic matter that feeds the root fungi.
Zinc deficiency in onion
Growth is restricted and leaves twist and bend, with yellow streaks and faint yellowing between the veins. Onion is very sensitive to zinc shortage. You see it most at this stage: early growth.
Why zinc deficiency happens in sibuyas
Soils above pH 6.5, over limed soils and heavy phosphorus. Onion is one of the crops with the highest zinc need (UW).
How to tell it apart
Herbicide injury also twists onion leaves. Check spray records. To be sure, soil test for zinc and a leaf test.
What to apply for zinc deficiency

Haifa gives 6 kg of zinc per hectare in the basal fertilizer only when a soil test confirms the shortage, since too much is toxic. For a standing crop TNAU gives a 0.5 percent zinc sulfate spray (5 g per liter) twice, 15 days apart.

Sold here with zinc: **Harvester Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Universal Harvester, Inc. (22 percent zinc), **Great Planters Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Agway Chemicals Corp. (21 percent zinc), **Zinc Sulphate Monohydrate** by Petbowe Trading Corporation (33 percent zinc) and **YaraVita ZINTRAC 700** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (40 percent zinc). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [fertilizer with zinc](/blog/micronutrients-for-rice), and the page on [zinc deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/zinc-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, test for zinc before planting on high pH soils.
Boron deficiency in onion

Plants grow distorted and stunted. Leaves turn brittle and grey green to blue green, young leaves mottle yellow green. Older leaves die back from the tip with sunken areas. Yellow lines across the leaf near the base turn into cracks, and bulbs can crack or split. You see it most at this stage: leaf growth to bulbing.
Why boron deficiency happens in sibuyas
Sandy soils low in organic matter, high pH soils and dry spells.
How to tell it apart
Calcium deficiency also kills leaf tips but without the cross cracks. To be sure, soil test for boron.
What to apply for boron deficiency

Haifa gives 1 kg of boron per hectare (about 9 kg Borax) mixed in before transplanting or sowing when the soil test is low. Warns not to exceed it. KAU gives about 10 kg Borax per hectare (4 kg per acre) to the soil, or a borax spray of 1 g per liter.

Sold here with boron: **Solubor** by Caldic Philippines Inc. (21 percent boron), **Etifert 11 (Borax Decahydrate)** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (11 percent boron), **YaraVita BORTRAC 150** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (11.1 percent boron) and **Grow More Liquid Chelate Boron** by Sagrex Corporation (10 percent boron). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [boron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/boron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, test before adding boron.
Magnesium deficiency in onion
Growth slows and older leaves turn evenly yellow along their whole length. Leaf tips may turn white and irregular oval patches form on the leaves. You see it most at this stage: mid season.
Why magnesium deficiency happens in sibuyas
Acid sandy soils and heavy potash.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen deficiency yellows the leaves too, but from the tips with stiff upright leaves. To be sure, soil test for magnesium.
What to apply for magnesium deficiency

Haifa gives 30 kg of magnesium per hectare before planting when the soil is low. TNAU gives a 0.5 percent magnesium sulfate spray (5 g Epsom salt per liter) twice, a week apart. KAU gives about 80 kg magnesium sulfate per hectare (32 kg per acre) in bands near the plants.

Sold here with magnesium: **Dolomite** by A6 Agrisource Limited Corporation (24 percent calcium and 11 percent magnesium), **YaraTera KRISTA MgS** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (16 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur), **Magnepro** by Ramgo International Corporation (16 percent MgO and 12.8 percent sulfur) and **Lucky Planters Magnesium Sulphate Heptahydrate (Epsom Salt)** by Mindanao Agriplus Corporation (16.27 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [complete fertilizer](/blog/complete-fertilizer-14-14-14), and the page on [magnesium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/magnesium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, use dolomite on acid soils.
Copper deficiency in onion
Bulb scales are thin and pale yellow and the bulbs lack firmness, maturing early. Leaves show tip burn with a mottled yellow look. You see it most at this stage: bulbing.
Why copper deficiency happens in sibuyas
Peat and other high organic matter soils, mostly when acid. Onion has a high copper need (UW).
How to tell it apart
Potassium deficiency also burns tips, without the pale thin scales. To be sure, soil test for copper on peat or muck soils.
What to apply for copper deficiency

TNAU gives a 0.3 percent copper sulfate spray (3 g per liter) twice, a week apart. For the soil, the University of Wisconsin bands about 2 to 4.5 kg of copper per hectare for onion. Says to stop once about 34 kg per hectare in total has gone on, to avoid toxicity.

Sold here with copper: **Omex Zynergy** by Jardine Distribution, Inc. (3.75 percent zinc and 2.11 percent copper), **Grower's Choice Copper Sulphate Pentahydrate** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (25 percent copper and 12 percent sulfur), **Agsmart Copper Sulphate** by AgSmart Corporation (25 percent copper and 12 percent sulfur) and **Liquid Chelate Copper w/ Sulfur** by Sagrex Corporation (5 percent copper and 2 percent sulfur). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [copper deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/copper-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, follow the soil test.
Manganese deficiency in onion

Growth is slow and maturity late. Older leaves yellow between the veins, then tips burn, leaves curl and die. Bulbing is delayed and many bulbs have thick necks. You see it most at this stage: before and during bulbing.
Why manganese deficiency happens in sibuyas
High pH and over limed soils, and soils high in organic matter. Onion needs a lot of manganese (UW).
How to tell it apart
Phosphorus deficiency also gives thick necks but leaves are dull green without the yellow between veins. To be sure, leaf test for manganese and a soil pH test.
What to apply for manganese deficiency
TNAU gives a 0.3 percent manganese sulfate spray (3 g per liter) twice, 15 days apart. The University of Wisconsin gives about 5.6 kg of manganese per hectare to the soil or 1.1 kg as a spray.

Sold here with manganese: **Manganese Sulfate** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (31 percent manganese), **Tierramino Mn** by Unilox Far East Resources Inc. (12 percent manganese and 7 percent N), **Multimate** by Agway Chemicals Corp. (1.8 percent Mn, 2.8 percent Zn, 4 percent N, 4.5 percent S (w/v)) and **Biozome** by Manchem Industries, Inc. (12 percent S, 12 percent Zn, 3 percent Mn, 1 percent Mg, 1 percent Fe, 1 percent Cu, 0.5 percent B, 0.05 percent Mo). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [manganese deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/manganese-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, do not over lime onion fields.

blocks.title: Let a soil test decide the rate
blocks.text: A soil test is the surest check for any onion nutrient deficiency. Before you buy, ask your Municipal Agriculture Office where to send a soil sample. The DA regional soil laboratories and the Bureau of Soils and Water Management test soil, and the result says how much of each fertilizer your sibuyas needs. That saves money, because extra fertilizer is money lost.

blocks.text: Onion nutrient deficiency questions

items.q: Why are my sibuyas leaves turning yellow?
items.a: The most common cause is nitrogen deficiency: pale, stiff, upright leaves that yellow and die back from the tips, and small bulbs. If the young leaves turn yellow first instead, look at sulfur deficiency.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes nitrogen deficiency in onion?
items.a: Haifa gives 200 to 300 kg N per hectare for dry bulbs: a quarter or so before planting and the rest in splits every 10 to 14 days for 2 to 2.5 months. For quick help TNAU gives a 1 percent urea (10 g per liter) or 2 percent DAP spray twice, a week apart.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes sulfur deficiency in onion?
items.a: Haifa gives 45 to 70 kg of sulfur per hectare, half at planting or transplanting and half before bulbing. On sulfur poor soil, 40 kg of sulfur per hectare as Ammonium sulfate 21 0 0 or single superphosphate with the usual NPK raised aggregatum onion yield by about a quarter (TNAU trial).

items.q: What fertilizer fixes potassium deficiency in onion?
items.a: Haifa advises putting 30 to 50 percent of the potash in before planting and the rest during bulb development, which increases bulb size. TNAU gives a 1 percent potassium sulfate spray (10 g per liter) twice, a week apart.

items.q: How do I know which nutrient my sibuyas lacks?
items.a: First look at where the change began, on the old leaves or the young ones, then at the color and the pattern. Next, confirm the onion nutrient deficiency with a soil test or a leaf test before you buy fertilizer.
